content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 5 up, 0 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 6. Sets: 98 (last week 98).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- Barbell Bench Press: 82.5 kg x 8 (last week 80 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.1%, 18 sets this week
- Barbell Back Squat: 100 kg x 6 (last week 97.5 kg x 6), estimated 1RM up 2.6%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Row: 70 kg x 8 (last week 67.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
- Romanian Deadlift: 90 kg x 8 (last week 87.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 8 sets this week
- Incline Dumbbell Press: 26 kg x 10 (last week 25 kg x 10), estimated 1RM up 4%, 8 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): Barbell Bench Press 82.5 kg x 8; Barbell Back Squat 100 kg x 6; Barbell Row 70 kg x 8; Romanian Deadlift 90 kg x 8; Incline Dumbbell Press 26 kg x 10.
Sets per muscle this week, where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for Chest, Back, Side delts, Rear delts, Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes, Biceps, Triceps; the others have no range): Chest 29 (above the range; last week 29), Back 24 (above the range; last week 24), Front delts 19 (last week 19), Side delts 11 (last week 11), Rear delts 10 (last week 10), Quads 14 (last week 14), Hamstrings 12 (last week 12), Glutes 22 (above the range; last week 22), Biceps 13 (last week 13), Triceps 22 (above the range; last week 22), Calves 2 (last week 2).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "Bigger chest".
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
No rules fired this period.

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 25 words.
2. actions: leave it empty: nothing fired, so give no advice.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in English.
